cand-a3-tp2.description: First Ascend (a3) draft: 2 cards, tensor-parallel 2 (30B MoE bf16 ~60 GB weights exceed one 64 GB card).
cand-a3-tp2.notes: Draft for the first Ascend round (2026-11-25): the run OOMed on one 910C ('Tried to allocate 2.56 GiB ... 57.61 GiB already allocated') -- 30B MoE bf16 ~60 GB weights on a 64 GB card leave no room for activations. num_gpus 2 + tp-size 2 shards the weights (~30 GB/card). VALIDATION PENDING -- a3 selects this profile (default matches no hardware). If the OOM persists past sharding, the crash log's allocation site guides the next knob (dit_cpu_offload). Derived from default plus tp-size.
